questions.help: NYSERDA publishes the disadvantaged communities map. If you are not sure, pick No: the total then shows the lower amount.

programs.name: PSEG Long Island heat pump rebate
programs.rules: Whole-home cold-climate heat pump on NEEP's list, sized for the whole home, with a participating contractor. Get pre-approval before work starts. Low-income households (under 60% of area median income) get $7,500, and moderate-income households get $5,000. PSEG Long Island is not part of NYS Clean Heat.

programs.name: NYS Clean Heat: heat pump water heater
programs.rules: Electric customers of the utility. Con Edison pays $1,000, the others $1,250. Con Edison runs a limited-time $1,500 offer for applications submitted September 1 to November 30, 2026.

programs.name: PSEG Long Island heat pump water heater
programs.rules: PSEG Long Island customers.

programs.name: NYSERDA Comfort Home
programs.rules: Seal-and-insulate packages ($2,500 or $3,000, plus $2,000 for windows) through Comfort Home contractors in participating counties. Check that your county is covered. Not added to your total.

programs.name: NYSERDA EmPower+
programs.rules: Income-eligible owners and renters of 1-4 family homes. Low income: free upgrades up to $12,000 upstate or $14,000 downstate. Moderate income: 50% of cost up to $6,000 upstate or $7,000 downstate. Federal Home Energy Rebate money is delivered through EmPower+.

notes: Clean Heat incentives are capped at 70% of project cost (85% in a disadvantaged community).
New York has no general solar rebate for market-rate homes, and the federal solar credit ended for 2026 installs.
Amounts are for a single-family home. Apartments get about half. Your contractor confirms your tier.
